trend: India restricted ashwagandha leaf in supplements in April 2026; root and root extract stay allowed
why: Clear, checkable regulatory fact that lets us state our root-only ingredient. Not used on X yet.
text:
India restricted ashwagandha leaf in supplements this year. Root and root extract are still allowed.

SILT Nights uses 300 mg of KSM-66, a root-only extract, and the dose is printed on the pack. If a label just says "ashwagandha", it's fair to ask which part of the plant.
